'''Clone battalion commander''', or simply '''battalion commander''', was the lowest of four [[Military rank/Legends|military ranks]] that a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] could hold in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], with the other three being [[clone regimental commander]], [[senior clone commander]], and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]]. Clone battalion commanders were placed in charge of [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], a role shared with [[Clone major/Legends|clone majors]]. Towards the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], when [[Color/Legends|color]] was used to denote a trooper's rank, clone battalion commanders, along with the other clone commander ranks, wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with yellow flashes. The battalion commander's [[Heads-up display/Legends|HUD]] glyph was two vertical dots.<ref name="TEGtW" /> 

As part of the Grand Army of the Republic's [[Order of Battle/Legends|Order of Battle]], battalion commanders were subordinate to clone regimental commanders, while clone majors were subordinate to clone battalion commanders.<ref name="TEGtW" /> [[CRC-09/571]] served as a battalion commander during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] and the [[Battle of Teyr]], before being promoted to the rank of [[clone regimental commander]].<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of battalion commander was introduced in [[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']], a [[2003]] novel written by [[Matthew Stover]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" />
